title: WidgetKit foundations
description: Widgets highlight your app’s most important content across the system, providing people with another opportunity to engage. Discover the different types of widgets and explore the qualities that make them memorable. Learn how to create widgets, keep them up to date, and offer ways for people to customize them through App Intents and dynamic styling.
